rule_name: Dispatched before the order was approved
Orders with >1 review (fans out CSAT joins)
Duplicate order_id in orders (breaks order grain)
Order lines referencing a missing seller
Order lines referencing a missing product
Order lines with no parent order
Orders with no order lines (no revenue attached)
Product rows with no category assigned
Zero freight charged on a physical shipment
Promise date earlier than the purchase date
